recipes.title: Web Chat Terminal (stop icon)

Width is 1024 on purpose: above 640px so the hint is not display:none, and no wider than the judge's 1024px long-edge cap so the 14px glyph is never downscaled (BOS-628).

recipes.title: Web Chat Terminal (file upload)

Width is 1024 so the Ctrl X 'to detach' hint is not display:none and the 14px lucide upload glyph is never downscaled by the judge's 1024px long-edge cap.

recipes.title: Web Chat Terminal (paste on mobile)
recipes.description: Chat terminal paste on a phone-width viewport (BOS-879). At 390x844 the touch-only icon-only 'Paste' control is visible in the top bar immediately before 'Upload file'; activating it falls back to the paste sheet (headless Chromium's clipboard read yields nothing), whose textarea opens focused. Typing 'hello from the clipboard' and pressing Send dispatches it through Terminal.paste(), and the staged attach socket echoes it so the text appears in the terminal canvas — proving a paste reaches the PTY rather than only the sheet. The final wait matches a single token rather than the whole phrase: per BOS-658 (scripts/proof-playwright-runner.mjs:57-60) xterm splits a rendered row into one span per style run and pads it with cell spaces, so an exact multi-word substring is the brittle form. The full literal stays in the step caption and in the video.

recipes.title: Web Session Detail (passing PR)
recipes.description: Product web session-detail header on a session with a passing PR: the action row reads Merge, Archive, Edit, Open GitHub — the BOS-700 pencil sits directly right of Archive and left of the GitHub action. No Stop button, no Branch/PR meta rows, no 'Switch account' button, status pill at left. Below it the desktop chat table lists three chats with an Agent column (claude/codex) and the delete column hugging the table's right edge.

recipes.title: Web Session Detail (no PR / Quick Chat)
recipes.description: Product web session-detail header on a Quick-Chat session with no PR: it shows the session title, New chat, and Archive, but NO Merge button and NO 'Switch account' button. Below it the desktop chat table carries an Agent column reading 'claude' immediately left of Created — BOS-700 renders it for SINGLE-agent sessions too, where before the ticket the column was dropped entirely.

recipes.title: Web Session Detail (rotation history)
recipes.description: Session-detail rotation history rendered below the chat list (BOS-432): a BOS-409 stale-failover-proxy-port event shows the FULL detail string in 24h date-aware time with NO 'rotation' fallback and NO 'Rotation history' heading (subtle, BOS-394). Cropped to the session-detail body so the rotation block is visibly below the CHAT table.

recipes.title: Web Sessions (a live row's past failure goes recessive)
recipes.description: BOS-855: the sessions list row for 'Proof live rebase run' reads a live 'working' status while its residual 'finalize failed (pr_skipped_no_github)' error line renders in the recessive treatment (the dimmed --text-faint palette plus a visually-hidden 'Earlier:' prefix) rather than the full danger red. The neighbouring rows keep their normal treatment, so the contrast between a present-tense status and a past-tense outcome is visible in one still. Cropped to the sessions table.

recipes.title: Web Session Detail (parked on an external event)
recipes.description: BOS-668/BOS-710: a session whose first chat is parked on an armed GitHub callback. The sub-header carries the info-styled reason notice 'waiting · awaiting checks_passed_ready on acme/my-app#668' — naming the trigger and the PR — and the chat table below shows that chat's status badge reading 'waiting' with a spinner beside a genuinely working chat that still spins. The parked chat must NOT read 'stopped': the wording matches the TUI's waiting-callback proof scenario byte for byte.

recipes.title: Web Session Detail (mobile)
recipes.description: Session-detail header at phone width (390px): the session title is on its own row above the action buttons, left-aligned and truncating with an ellipsis when long; the action buttons sit on the row below, right-aligned. Icon-only chat buttons. Below it, three stacked chat cards whose top meta row reads '<time> <status> x' — NO agent name, because the Agent column is desktop-only since BOS-700 even though these chats mix claude and codex. The delete x buttons form one straight vertical line down the card's right gutter and the status pills line up with them (BOS-541).

recipes.title: Web Accounts
recipes.description: Accounts settings page (/settings/accounts): the rotation-accounts table with Provider, Label, Daemon, Health, and Usage columns plus the per-row action group. The Daemon column names the daemon each account is registered on, so accounts aggregated from more than one daemon stay attributable. Disabled rows use the shared dormant treatment; no Active/Disabled status column is rendered. One account's provider cannot determine utilization, so its Usage cell shows an em dash rather than a fabricated 0%.
